faq.title: Pricing and licensing questions
faq.q1: What does "buy once + update rights" actually mean?
faq.a1pre: When you buy Personal Pro you pay once and
faq.a1s2: {updateMonths} months of rights to new versions
faq.a1post: . When those update rights lapse you are under no obligation to renew — the version you installed keeps working forever and is never locked or downgraded.
faq.q2: What does the early-bird "price locked for life" mean?
faq.a2mid: up front (including {updateMonths} months of updates), and every future update-rights renewal stays locked at
faq.a2post: for life. The standard prices are ${proStandard} up front and ${proRenewStandard}/year to renew.
faq.q3: Once update rights expire, does the software still work? Will it lock me out?
faq.a3pre: It absolutely still works. PromptBox is local-first and offline by principle, and the app runtime
faq.a3s1: never checks an expiry date and will never time-bomb
faq.a3post: . Expired update rights only mean you can't download versions released after that point; the version you own is entirely unaffected.
faq.q4: How is "lifetime updates (${lifetime})" different from Personal Pro?
faq.a4pre: Personal Pro is buy-once plus an optional annual update-rights renewal. Lifetime updates is a single payment of ${lifetime} USD that gives you every Pro feature and
faq.a4s1: every future release on this product line, permanently
faq.a5pre: A licence designed for companies and for-profit organisations (${commercial} USD / seat / year). It is functionally identical to Pro — what you are buying is commercial compliance and support for the developer. It runs on the honour system (the offline app has no expiry lock) and includes a
faq.a5post: bundle, with invoices for corporate purchasing.
faq.q6: How do I buy it? How do payment and invoicing work?
faq.a6: Nothing is on sale yet — every button on the four plan cards is a sign-up form, and we will email you when checkout opens. Payments will then be handled by a Merchant of Record platform, which collects and remits VAT and other taxes worldwide and issues the receipt; once payment clears, the licence key is emailed to you and verified offline inside the app, with no connection required. The payment methods and invoice formats we actually support will be published when checkout opens.
